summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses traditional and new practices at wedding ceremonies regarding speeches, Birchat Kohanim, songs, and prayers. He reviews what was historically done in Halab and other communities compared to customs seen today.

Should the bride and groom recite prayers during the wedding ceremony?
